result.title: LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion
result.summary: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.

AI.brief_summary: LogCDM 是一个紧凑的日志会话异常检测器，融合三路信号：小因果 Transformer 的下一事件惊讶度、会话转移图与正常参考图之间的图注意力嵌入距离、以及被证明等于频率加权卡方散度的转移漂移统计量；三者经 sigmoid 门控融合，约 8.1–8.8M 参数，CPU 下 5.5–10.5 ms 打分。
AI.relevance_reason: 把序列转成转移图、以核漂移做统计检验并给出逐边告警分解，以及门控权重指示「每类数据依赖哪路信号」，可能为 LVR 中多源视觉/文本证据的融合与 latent 推理轨迹漂移的可解释评价提供线索，但领域相距较远，是否可迁移需核查。
